dedupe_keys.name: fleece energy use and occupant behaviour dataset for net zero energy affordable senior housing virginia

description: flEECe is an energy use and occupant behaviour dataset for six affordable housing units for seniors in Virginia that were designed to the net-zero energy standard but are not performing to it, collected as part of a multiphase longitudinal affordable housing study by researchers at Virginia Tech and described in Scientific Data in November 2019. It covers nine months and provides energy data at a 1 Hz sampling rate for four circuits (main, hot water heater, dryer and HVAC) from NEXI energy monitor loggers, WegoWise utility tracking data, building specifications, occupancy, weather data, energy use of neighbouring buildings, and survey measures of occupant behaviour, energy literacy and ecological perceptions; example Jupyter notebooks show how to analyse the time series. Coverage: six units at one affordable senior housing development in Virginia, USA. Access: free download from the Open Science Framework project 2ax9d (created May 2019, last modified November 2019). Licence: CC BY 4.0 on OSF, and the descriptor is CC BY 4.0. Caveats: a very small sample at one site, and the utility bill PDFs are only partly included. Simulation uses: calibrating household energy models and occupant behaviour models for high-performance housing, and studying the performance gap. Related records: the ASHRAE Global Occupant Behavior Database and the Building Data Genome 2 meter data.
